class.name: VisionOSAnchorTracker
class.brief_description: A tracker for a visionOS world anchor.
class.description: Represents an ARKit world anchor. Ordinary local anchors successfully added to the provider persist across sessions; shared anchors do not. Persistence does not imply a currently usable tracked pose. Create these through [method VisionOSXRInterface.create_spatial_anchor] or [method VisionOSSpatialAnchorCapability.create_new_anchor]. An anchor may temporarily stop being tracked when the user moves away from it; watch [signal tracking_state_changed] to react. The [code]default[/code] pose is raw [code]origin_from_anchor[/code] in meters; [method XRPose.get_adjusted_transform] applies world scale and reference frame. An initially returned tracker has no valid pose until tracked provider data arrives. Use the capability's request completion and current-generation cache to distinguish successful addition, localization, and confirmed removal.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], ARKit is currently tracking this anchor and its pose is valid.
The UUID ARKit assigned to this anchor. Store it to identify the anchor again in a later session.
If [code]true[/code], this anchor is shared with nearby SharePlay participants and is not persistent across sessions.

signal.name: tracking_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when ARKit starts or stops tracking this anchor.
